visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in a brightly lit Japanese restaurant. The camera focus is on a wooden table set with a simmering 'Mizutaki' chicken hotpot on a portable burner and a bowl of grilled chicken rice. Steam rises prominently from the pot. (2) A hand enters the frame from the left, placing a rectangular tray containing condiments and small side dishes next to the hotpot. A person across the table wears a red striped shirt. (3) A close-up reveals the hotpot ingredients: large chunks of chicken, white meatballs, leafy greens, and mushrooms in a cloudy white broth. The gas flame flickers underneath. (4) A young woman with dark hair tied back is seen taking a photograph of the feast with her smartphone. She is wearing a dark grey shirt. (5) The woman uses a large wooden spoon to scoop the white broth into a small bowl, then takes a sip. She looks directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. (6) The camera zooms into a black lacquered bowl filled with grilled chicken pieces and crispy fried chicken skin strips over rice. A garnish of green leaves sits on top. (7) A row of seven small ceramic condiment jars with wooden spoons is displayed on the table. The lighting is warm and highlights the textures of the pottery. (8) The woman is shown mixing a red spice paste from one of the jars into her chicken rice bowl. The background shows the wooden partitions of the restaurant. (9) A piece of succulent chicken is pulled from the hotpot using wooden chopsticks, dripping with milky soup. The visual emphasis is on the tenderness of the meat. (10) The final shot pans across the minimalist, upscale interior of the restaurant 'Torimabushi,' showing wooden shelves with plates and a distinctive straw lampshade.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 福岡必吃美食推薦. [Slogan]: 水炊鍋一吃套餐. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 大多數水炊鍋都要2人以上才能點, 但這間竟然有個人套餐！ (3) [Subtitle]: 而且還是三吃型態. (4) [Subtitle]: 水炊鍋小小一鍋, 料卻給得超有誠意. (5) [Subtitle]: 裡頭的雞肉軟嫩又大塊, 吃起來超滿足！ (6) [Subtitle]: 湯底本身沒加鹽需要自己調味, 但雞肉的香氣已經超濃郁. [Subtitle]: 單喝也很讚. (7) [Subtitle]: 烤雞蓋飯. [Subtitle]: 這碗我非常喜歡, 現烤雞肉炭香味十足. (8) [Subtitle]: 裡面還有酥酥的焦香雞皮, 真的太讚了. (9) [Subtitle]: 桌上擺放了7種調味料, 吃一吃可以隨意變化口味. (10) [Subtitle]: 第三吃是把鍋裡的料撈出來, 加進飯裡拌著吃. [Subtitle]: 每一口都超香超過癮！ (11) [Slogan]: 店名：水炊．雞肉料理 とりまぶし (Torimabushi). [Subtitle]: 店內位置不多, 建議來之前先訂位喔.
